fills: the occasion components after the fixed ones in Components
formula: for each supplied component, in order: its name unchanged, a role as a short noun phrase, then one paragraph
paragraph slot order: fill, border, radius, padding, type, contents, state, then an optional closing 'only' or 'never' line
rules: a fill var(--immersive-X) always with its text var(--immersive-on-X)
radius and padding as var(--borderRadius-…) and var(--space-…) from the supplied picks
type as role names from typeRoles, such as title2 or body
exactly one entry per supplied component, in order, keeping its name
